concerns.text: The pipeline filters counterfactual video pairs using a **cosine similarity ≥ 0.9** between frozen FlowNet‑C feature vectors (step 0.3.d‑e‑f). These same FlowNet‑C features are later used as the **fixed feature extractor** for training the linear classifier. By selecting only pairs that are already highly similar in the feature space that will be used for learning, the dataset is biased toward trivial consistency cases. Consequently, any observed improvement in ΔAcc or motion‑only accuracy may stem from this pre‑filtering rather than from the Counterfactual Consistency loss itself, making the validation of the loss’s effect circular.
